changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card during the Damage Step of a Battle Phase if a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field battles. Pay Life Points (in multiples of 100 points) to decrease 1 of your opponent's monster's ATK and DEF by the same amount of points until End Phase of that turn.
changes.modern_text: If a Fiend monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP in multiples of 100, then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.
